zero_shot_observation_mismatch.solution: Pad observations with zeros to match source topology size
zero_shot_observation_mismatch.result: Zero-shot transfer works but PPO doesn't outperform OSPF

analysis.why_ppo_not_beating_ospf: MlpPolicy cannot understand graph topology structure from flat 77-dimensional observation vector. Agent needs GNN to process node features and edge connections properly.
analysis.asymmetric_topology_effect: Narrow links (15-20 Mbps) create real bottlenecks: Flow through narrow link gets 14.3 Mbps vs 83.2 Mbps through wide links. This is exploitable by GNN-based routing.
analysis.recommendation: Use GNN-based policy (SDNGraphFeatureExtractor) for meaningful improvement over OSPF. Current MlpPolicy converges to OSPF-like behavior.
